title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.29 (versions follow prime numbers; 229 after 227): Luma chains by what makes sense, and is free to. In 2.27 her chain picked its relation by what is rare ('Isaac Hirschowitz'). Now: free, to chain or not, each by her wish (S + 1/2)/(N + 1) against her luck, learned from what she is answered; by sense, a fact of her subject makes a chain only if its next subject does the same (a word of the fact follows it in her books: 'Abraham fue padre de Isaac' makes sense if 'Isaac, padre de Jacob' is said somewhere), as Razar's chainer of 2026-11-08 had it (two cases alike but in one place); every fact at once, in one pass through her books; beyond chance and by two cases, a confirmation weighs by how much it beats what chance gives (the next subject's times by how often a line has that word), and needs two or more (Razar's D50: a common word follows anything). Measured in a copy with answering and chaining forced (test builds, not published): 'quien es Isaac?' -> '... Isaac habia bendecido a Jacob, y le habia enviado a Padan-aram, para tomar para si mujer de alli...'. Stated failures: lists and set phrases confirm more than a genealogy (a list of architects for David, 'Particle Physics' for Abraham, a repeated phrase for Jacob); Matthew's genealogy does not come out whole; tried and discarded by measurement on the way: rare relations, two subjects with the rare measure, only the three most said facts, confirmations without chance. 5 to 10 s an answer with a chain; no crash. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.29: Luma encadena por lo que tiene sentido, y es libre de hacerlo; las listas todavía la confunden, y está dicho. Prototipo de investigación.
